description: This file defines classes, structures, and constants related to Bluetooth SDP (Service Discovery Protocol) socket communication, including Payload management, PDU (Protocol Data Unit) handling, and socket classes for client and server communication within the Thunder Bluetooth namespace.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth SDP payload, capable of pushing and popping various data types, including UUIDs, strings, integers, sequences, and buffers, with support for descriptors and descriptors reading.

classes.name: PDU
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth SDP Protocol Data Unit, managing serialization/deserialization, and providing methods for inspecting and setting PDU data, including handling of transaction IDs, types, and error codes.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: Abstract base class for Bluetooth SDP client socket communication, managing connection state, MTU sizes, and data transmission.

classes.name: ServerSocket
classes.description: Derived from ClientSocket, manages incoming SDP requests, processes PDUs, and sends responses, with virtual method OnPDU for handling specific request logic.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Methods to push various data types into the Payload, including UUIDs, strings, booleans, integers, sequences, buffers, and custom builders.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Methods to extract data from the Payload, including UUIDs, strings, sequences, buffers, and handling of descriptors.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the PDU into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into the PDU structure.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the PDU type, transaction ID, and payload content.
